named.name: a 3-bettor is 4-bet and 5-bets; the 4-bettor then calls the 5-bet
a full-raise all-in is a raise; an all-in that is not a full raise is a call
two raises come back to the 3-bettor: a different spot, not counted
an opener who is 3-bet is not a re-raiser; a single raised pot has no opportunity
an unattributed fold and a forced action are not admitted; the flop is not read
hole cards in the log change nothing
